detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

My Mac hit critical memory twice in a week. I asked Claude Code to build a memory pressure menu bar app, and had it that day.

Its top 3 apps found two easy wins:
• Docker's VM: 8 GB with no container running, filled by an agent's builds. Settings → Resources → Memory limit: 4 GB.
• Chrome: 4.4 GB, one process per site. Settings → Performance → Memory Saver: Maximum.

Agents start heavy jobs you never see. Watch memory pressure.

#ClaudeCode #Docker #macOS
